items.title: INV-050/MECH-180 calibration-fixed replication of the MEL third-drive coupling (resolves GFLAG-0002)
items.note: CALIBRATION-FIXED replication resolving GFLAG-0002. SUPERSEDES V3-EXQ-861b, whose decisive C2 independence leg failed 2/3 seeds on a diagnosed CALIBRATION-NOISE artifact (confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-861b_2026-08-13, ratified by 2026-08-13 /governance). 861b's C1 (within-seed graded MEL->duration monotonicity) replicated CLEANLY on all 3 genuinely-disjoint seeds [7,271,883]; C2 (ARM_3_HIGH_ON duration factor > pinned OFF baseline of 1.0) failed 2/3 because mel_reference was a SINGLE 3-episode point estimate whose ~3x cross-seed sampling spread (ARM_0 factor 0.636-1.719) was comparable to the effect size, deflating ARM_3 factor below 1.0 on seeds 7/271 (0.517, 0.612). | THE FIX (autopsy Sec 8): (1) mel_reference = MEAN of CALIB_DRAWS=5 independent repeated calibration draws x CALIB_EPISODES_PER_DRAW=6 (30 calib episodes vs 861b's 3); mean variance ~ single-draw/5 and the per-draw spread ESTIMATES the residual noise. (2) C2 threshold is now UNCERTAINTY-AWARE: ARM_3 mean_duration_factor >= 1.0 + K_CALIB_MARGIN(=2) * calib_rel_sd_of_mean (SD-of-mean of the draws), replacing 861b's bare factor>1.0 that a single noisy draw could flip. Count comparisons retained reported-only. (3) SEEDS reused [7,271,883] to isolate the calibration fix as the SINGLE change from 861b; seed-independence from the ORIGINAL {42,123,456} set is already established (audited disjoint at runtime), so seeds are NOT the defect. Per the autopsy, re-queuing at the SAME calibration on a fresh triplet is recommended AGAINST (~1/3 coin-flip chance, burns compute without raising discriminator confidence). | Two C2-fail labels both non_contributory (mel_control_degenerate = OFF not pinned; mel_coupling_below_calibration_noise_floor = ON factor did not clear the noise band); the load-bearing weakens branch is reachable ONLY when C2 PASSES, so a calibration-limited C2 can never spuriously weaken INV-050 (the 861b failure mode). | GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout = the C2 discriminator under the FIXED multi-draw calibration + uncertainty threshold; present in no recorded manifest (861b recorded neither the repeated-draw noise nor a margin-scaled factor); the fix is a NEW calibration-procedure manipulation -> not recoverable -> run. | RE-DERIVE BRAKE (Step 2.5b): does NOT fire -- this is measurement/calibration instrument repair (recommended_epistemic_category=standard, not substrate_ceiling), the autopsy ran the brake and found it released; no ree_core substrate build owed (recommended_substrate_queue_entry.action=none). | SUBSTRATE OVERLAP (2.5c): no open corrupting entry overlaps; same three DEGRADING arm-symmetric entries as 861b (SD-MECH267-CEM-SELECTION-FIX, SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING, SD-QUEUE-SEED-ENFORCEMENT). | claim_ids=[INV-050,MECH-180]: INV-050 both DVs under test (direction follows C1a+C1c grid incl weakens branch); MECH-180 capped at 'mixed' (DV3 spindle_density descoped, MECH-122 substrate unbuilt). Does NOT clear MECH-180's v3_pending. | DV-symmetry (604c): manipulation is world_rule_shift_interval (multiplicative duration scale on integer counts) -- NOT invariant under broadcast-additive, monotone-rescaling, or permutation symmetries of the count DVs; ARM_4_HIGH_OFF disconnects the manipulation by design (C2 control, not scored for dose-response). | Smoke PASS (dry-run: 3 cells, multi-draw calib exercised n=2 rel_sd=0.236 rel_sd_of_mean=0.167, ep N/102 progress, 3 verdict lines, OFF pinned factor=1.0, manifest carries calibration_redesign + config calib_draws/per_draw/k_calib_margin + substrate_hash, relocated out of evidence/). validate_experiments --strict OK 0 warnings. PROMOTES NOTHING until /governance applies the verdict -- resolves GFLAG-0002 once it lands and scores.

Successor-in-spirit to 464e/467e, NOT a supersede.

items.title: Uncensored survival-to-death fishtank, TRUE single-life design -- MULTI-SEED re-run of V3-EXQ-920 (explicit --seeds 0..7; supersedes 920's 1-of-8-seeds execution defect)
items.note: Re-run of V3-EXQ-920 with the SEED-COUNT WORKAROUND applied. V3-EXQ-920 FAILed for an execution/wiring reason only: its queue entry correctly declared "seeds": 8 but carried no "args", and experiment_runner.py's run_experiment() builds subprocess CLI args ONLY from the item's "args" field (raw_args = item.get('args', []))  -- the declarative "seeds" count feeds only the progress-bar denominator (_run_axis_count), never a --seeds CLI arg  -- so the driver's own argparse default (--seeds default=[0]) silently ran a SINGLE seed. n_uncensored_deaths_total=1 < MIN_UNCENSORED_DEATHS_TOTAL=4 -> load-bearing sufficient_uncensored_deaths FAIL. The one seed that ran behaved exactly as pre-registered (genuine health_depleted death at 1475 steps, pct_right_censored_pooled=0.0 -- literally zero censoring; the self-route label '...still_censoring_dominated' is a hardcoded else-branch string, NOT a measurement finding). Governance-ratified routing: failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-916-916a-917-920-fishtank-cluster_2026-08-12.md Target 4 (status confirmed, interactive AskUserQuestion gate 2026-08-12) recommends exactly this re-queue as V3-EXQ-920a with explicit "args":["--seeds",...]. THE ONLY CHANGE from 920 is the added "args" field; the driver script is byte-identical and unchanged. Workaround CONFIRMED by dry-run smoke (--dry-run --seeds 0 1 -> two 'Seed N Condition' boundaries and two 'verdict: PASS' lines, rc=0, z_goal_stream active_frac=0.998 no writer defect); the runner passes args verbatim so --seeds 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 executes all 8. This is the exact infra defect the autopsy identified; the general fix (enforce queue-declared seed count into --seeds, or fix the driver default) is governance's / a separate infra chip's to apply and is NOT re-proposed here. GOV-REUSE-1 (2.4): the decisive readout (a TRUE single-continuous-life uncensored survival-time distribution at n>=4) is recorded in NO existing manifest -- 920 produced n=1, every prior 906-lineage segment was capped at 500 steps -- not recoverable, run required. Re-derive brake (2.5b): claim_ids=[], N/A. Downstream: the multi-seed within-life descriptive trend analysis (chip-20260812-exq920-multiseed-degradation-retrospective) runs once this lands, and feeds the DV set + sleep cadence for the matched-arm causal follow-up (chip-20260814-queue-causal-sleep-matched-arm). Diagnostic; excluded from governance confidence/conflict scoring. Ethics preflight (2.6): all-false / allow -- pre-ethical V3 instrumentation, SENT-0 boundary, same design as 920/912 already adjudicated.
